# Artag Dev — AI-Friendly Site Summary

> Full-stack software architect specializing in scalable systems, zero-downtime migrations, and process automation. Based in Colombia, available globally.

## What I Do

- **Full-Stack Development**: React, Next.js, TypeScript, Node.js, Python
- **System Architecture**: Microservices, event-driven systems, database optimization
- **Process Automation**: Workflow automation, API integrations, data pipelines
- **Cloud Infrastructure**: Docker, Kubernetes, AWS, Vercel
- **Payment Integration**: Stripe, payment gateways, subscription systems

## Key Facts

- 32K+ users served across projects
- 99.99% uptime maintained
- Self-taught developer since 2019

- Available for remote work worldwide
